name: Wal
prior: A playable whale synth exists as a web toy: WhaleSynth (2017, browser; several species, 'chorus (number of whales), anchor (ocean depth), sonar (whale clicks)', 'changing pitch as you play', plus an Ableton Live instrument version; whether it synthesises or plays samples is not stated in the summaries; VS: djmag.com whale sounds article, kottke.org 2017/02 whalesynth, adsrsounds.com browser-synth-whale, audiopluginsforfree.com/whalesynth). Sampled: Spitfire LABS Granular Whalesong (free, granular on whale recordings; VS: bedroomproducersblog.com 2020/05/29), Soundiron Whale Drum (Kontakt percussion with whale-like resonance; VS), Necromare Whale Song VST (2011 sample player; VS), forum practice 'pitch hydrophone recordings' (VS: dogsonacid.com thread 514382). Not whale: Glo Polyphonic Whale (hardware soundscape box; VS: synthanatomy tag). Myzel: Stimme = glottal PeriodicWave into 3 vowel formants with breath, vibrato after 0.25 s, choir (APP 4116-4200), no onset contour, formants from a vowel table not from f. Not found: a scale-locked whale call with onset contour, overshoot glide, pulsed phonation and underwater propagation under a finger, on mobile or desktop. Rare: the species exists as a toy and as samples; the playable contour instrument does not.
costNotes: Native: carrier osc + AM osc + sub osc (3 x 0.03) + AM gain + 2 formant BQ + LP BQ (3 x ~0.09 with gains) + DelayNode + loop LP + feedback gain + ~5 gains -> ~15 nodes ~0.55-0.6 (idea says 0.7; slightly high). L3 (two callers L/R, 3rd formant, two combs, panners) ~1.2. The comb (70-110 ms) is a DelayNode in a cycle: minimum delay is one render quantum (R: webaudio.md section 7), 70 ms is far above that, fine. PeriodicWave 'wal' cached in A.waves (APP 3781). Two implementation hazards: (1) frequency.setValueCurveAtTime for the onset contour blocks the AudioParam for its duration - any glideTo/setTargetAtTime scheduled inside that window throws NotSupportedError in Chromium (overlapping events), and a throw in setF kills the note; cancelAndHoldAtTime is not implemented in Firefox (A) - so the contour must be built from setValueAtTime + exponentialRamp/setTargetAtTime segments on a separate gain into detune (the v.mod bus already sums into detune, APP 2831-2836), leaving osc.frequency free for setF glides. (2) The overshoot glide (ramp to nf x 2^(0.3/12) then setTargetAtTime nf) on frequency while Bebung rides detune is fine; min 0.25 s glide must be bypassed when Ruf < 0.2 as the idea says, else fast melodies smear.
soundHeld: The chain is a bright PeriodicWave (1/n^0.8 ~ saw) through two resonant peaks at 2.2 f and 4.5 f (Q 4) and a lowpass: because the formants track f they carry no vowel identity - this is a resonant saw with a fixed spectral shape, i.e. an ordinary synth voice; the whale is entirely in the behaviour: the -7 st upward onset glide with overshoot over 0.3-0.9 s, the 6-16 Hz pulse AM, the sub-octave and the comb. Those behaviours are convincing for slow low melodies (v.oct -1, 55-110 Hz: the AM at 6-16 Hz reads as 'pulsed moan', the contour as a call) and unconvincing above ~250 Hz, where the same recipe is a tremolo'd synth lead with portamento. Hoehe = Rufform (raises formants x2^0.6, AM rate, LP) is a decent continuous timbre axis. Two modulations collide: comb at 70-110 ms = 9-14 Hz flutter plus pulse AM at 6-16 Hz = two incommensurate slow modulations = rhythmic mush on sustained notes; 'underwater' is better served by lowpass + the mixer's reverb than by a 10 Hz comb (use 20-40 ms with lower feedback if a comb is wanted). Against Stimme: distinct in behaviour (contour, pulse, sub, no vowel) but with Ruf = 0 and Puls = 0 it is a dull formant saw - the defaults must keep Ruf >= 0.4. Humpback 'growl' phonation sits at 20-40 Hz pulse rates, so the AM range should reach ~40 Hz at full Rufform.
soundBurst: Gate < 0.3 s = 'Klicksalve': AM at 12-25 Hz on the tonal carrier is a tremolo'd tone, not clicks - sperm-whale codas are broadband impulses; the salvo needs noise/impulse bursts through the formants (10 ms, 12-25/s) with the carrier at -20 dB, then it is a distinctive, rhythmic Puls lane sound. Longer gates (>= 0.3 s) with the contour on gate x 0.6 give a short rising call with a -3 st release glide = recognisable, good at slow tempi; at 1/8 notes consecutive calls with 0.8 s release overlap and the comb tails add flutter. Burst hits at high pitch are ordinary synth blips.
failureModes: setValueCurveAtTime contour blocks osc.frequency for 0.3-0.9 s; any setF glide inside throws and silences the voice - build the contour on a detune gain instead.
Above ~250 Hz the recipe is a tremolo'd synth lead with portamento; whale identity lives below ~150 Hz - default v.oct -1 and say so in the library.
Comb flutter (9-14 Hz) against pulse AM (6-16 Hz) = rhythmic mush on held notes; shorten the comb or drop it for the mixer reverb.
Ruf = 0 / Puls = 0 defaults collapse into a Stimme-like formant saw; clamp defaults and keep the contour minimum at 0.2.
Klicksalve as AM on a tonal carrier is tremolo, not clicks; needs impulse/noise bursts.
Inertia (>= 0.25 s glide, overshoot) breaks fast melodic play; must be conditional on Ruf and on glide distance.
Formants proportional to f carry no vowel; if a 'throat' identity is wanted, anchor F1/F2 to absolute Hz bands (180-700 / 500-1800 are specified as clamps but only bite at the extremes).
verdict: Rare: whale calls are playable today only as a 2017 browser toy (WhaleSynth, with an Ableton version) and as sampled/granular libraries (LABS Granular Whalesong, Soundiron Whale Drum); a scale-locked call with onset contour, overshoot glide, pulsed phonation and sub-octave under a finger is unoccupied. Native at ~0.6 units (L3 ~1.2), but the onset contour must not use setValueCurveAtTime on osc.frequency (it blocks the param and a setF glide inside it throws) - put it on a detune gain. Held it convinces only low and slow (55-150 Hz, legato), where the pulse AM and contour read as a moan; above that it is a resonant saw with tremolo and portamento, and the 10 Hz comb fights the AM. Puls: the 'Klicksalve' needs impulses, not AM on a tone; longer gates give a nice short call. Keep it as a bass/ambient voice with Ruf and Puls defaults clamped high, the comb shortened or dropped, and v.oct -1 as its home.
